odc_type: Incorrect logic in token parsing loop
observation_summary: The parser incorrectly processes and splits tokens that should have been treated as non-option arguments, leading to an unexpected number of arguments in the command line.
reasoning_summary: The PosixParser is designed to handle 'bursting' of combined short options (e.g., -azc). When the 'stopAtNonOption' flag is set to true, the parser should stop processing tokens as soon as it encounters a character that is not a valid option. The failing test 'testStopBursting' demonstrates that the parser incorrectly continues to process the remainder of the token string even after encountering a non-option character, resulting in an incorrect number of arguments being returned in the command line object.
